description:
The image depicts a bathroom sink with two white oval-shaped sinks on a white countertop, accompanied by a mirror and a wooden cabinet underneath.

* The bathroom sink is a rectangular, white countertop with two oval-shaped sinks.
	+ The sinks are positioned side by side, with a small gap between them.
	+ Each sink has a silver faucet attached to it.
	+ There is a small white towel placed on the left side of the counter.
* The mirror is attached to the wall above
